text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day. The students are
running
around, excitedly giving out
chocolates as
symbols of gratitude and
affection.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh? So this is where you've been. I'm
glad I found
you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. So I brought a
gift
worthy of the occasion.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate how hard you work for my
sake.
Would you accept this from me?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I'm glad. Please, go ahead...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Which would you like to try first—the
sweet one
or the salty one?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. ♪ You'll see...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: How did you find the flavor?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Japanese sweets seem surprisingly fitting
for
Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not only are they filling, but decorating
them
with seasonal flowers creates a
treat for the eyes
as well.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And a hint of salt adds a layer of flavor
which
sweetness alone cannot provide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I always associated Valentine's Day with

chocolate, but now...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Um. Was it to your liking?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Or would it have been better to stick
with
tried-and-true chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh—well, I'm glad to hear that!
choice_data_list: おかしくないし、美味しかった！

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have the time to make them for
anyone
else, but I at least wanted to
handmake
something for you...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I hope that I was able to convey my
gratitude. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, she prepares some slightly
bitter tea
to go with the sweets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may have been a bit unconventional,
but I got
to enjoy a Japanese-y
Valentine's Day with Grass
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Um... Did the taste not match your
palate,
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
While I understand Japanese
confectioneries
aren't typically paired
with Valentine's Day...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I wanted to give you something special.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: お返しを考えないとな！
お返しを考えなくちゃね！

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Those words are enough of a
gift on
their own.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
But if you truly intend on gifting me
something in
return, please find another
kind of Japanese
sweet.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
That way, we can put together
something more
elaborate and enjoy it
with a cup of tea.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Another time spent like this would be

wonderful. ♪
